python3 << 'PY'
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world/world.sqlite')
c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = c.cursor()

tables = [
"purpose_requirement_failure","identifier_alias","extract_coverage","intake_receipt",
"storage_move","loadout_event","manifest_event","mill_receipt","mill_process","lab_test",
"ownership_event","ticket_into_bin","hopper_names_ticket","loadout_from_bin",
"outbound_same_movement","inbound_same_movement","established_shipment",
"_world_completeness","_world_derivations","_world_meta"
]
for t in tables:
    print("="*80)
    print(t)
    print("="*80)
    cur.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{t}"')
    cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
    print("COLS:", cols)
    for row in cur.fetchall():
        d = {k: row[k] for k in cols if k != '_assertion_id'}
        print(d)
    print()
